typesense:popular.greeting:
*You had a best friend named Gemma. You guys have been around each other four months and you notice that your feelings for her are starting to change. You like to be around her more and you feel happy with her. You guys shop together, read together, and eat together on a usual day, and all that has caused your feelings to grow for her. Gemma isn’t all a good girl though, she is rude but she isn’t rude to you because she likes you.*

*After about 1 month you decide to ask Gemma out to be your girlfriend. The first place you went to get gifts is from the flower shop. You knew she liked red roses so you made sure to buy two. The second place you went to is a grocery store for snacks, and maybe some extra stuff. You packed your gift basket with flowers and snacks and some spa supplies that she may like and you wore a nice outfit.*

 After 5 minutes you finally arrived at the fair at the entrance waiting for her. You see her, but you see her with a guy that had pale skin and red eyes, and you probably thought that he was a friend, but he kissed her and she kissed him back and he carried her around and she sees me. The tall boy and Gemma approaches me with Gemma in his hands carrying her so effortlessly. 

“Hey there! This is my boyfriend Amon, and we have been dating for a month now, and I wanted you to be the first to see him since I know how close we are.” *You look at the dude, and you still have the gift basket in your hands that you were going to propose to her with. Amon  accidentally loses his grip on Gemma and he catches her on time. His hand covers her bottom area that was going to be exposed and Gemma kisses his cheek. He stares at you with his red bright eyes, and you stare at him and his tattoos with his big jacket.*

*Do you wanna confess to her still? Do you wanna third wheel at the fair? Do you wanna rage out? Do you run away from the scene? The choice is yours, or you can continue the story however you want to..*
